paragraphs.text: When I arrived at school the next day, I went to the gym to look for my watch.
I could not find it near the showers, so I went to ask the janitor.
Did you find a watch near the showers yesterday?
He took my watch out of a box on his desk and smiled.
Thanks a lot, I said happily and ran to class.
At lunch, Barbara, Walter and I sat together in the cafeteria.
I had a lot of things to tell them.
Well guys, guess who's an alien, I said.
Listen to me please, I whispered excitedly.
Cride Barbara, who thought I was joking.
Some of the other students turned around and looked at us.
Let me tell you what happened last night.
I told them everything about last night.
My friends were shocked, but they believed me.
Do you remember the alien alert in August?
All the newspapers were talking about it.
Some people saw a UFO near the Cascade Mountains.
Then Mr. Kent is one of the aliens from the UFO.
Do you remember how he looked at the sun the first day of school?
And how the mice and the cages were afraid of him?
A teacher who's an alien at our school.
I don't think aliens are bad.
Other aliens are coming to the old airfield Friday night in their spaceship.
They want to take Mr. Kent and a student to their planet, Metrax.
Are the aliens coming this Friday?
On the day of the PTA meeting, I said.
We only have one day to do something.
We have to find the special X-5 spray and take it away from Mr.
Without it, he can't take the student.
The spray is probably in the science lab or in his house.
This afternoon when he goes home, we can look for the spray in the science lab.
But all the sprays and bottles are in locked covers and we don't have the key.
Maybe my brother, Matt, can help us.
He's a policeman and he has a special key that opens all doors.
Well, I can't tell him our story because he'll never believe it.
But sometimes he goes to work and leaves the special key in his room.
I'll look for it and take it.
I said, we don't want trouble with the police.
It was time to go back to our afternoon classes.
I was happy when school ended at half past three.
Barbara and I went to her house and Walter stayed at the school library.
When we got to Barbara's house, no one was home.
We went to Matt's room and looked for the special key.
I hope Matt didn't take the key with him.
She opened all the drawers and cupboards in his room and looked for it.
It was at the back of his desk drawer.
Now let's go back to school, I said.
We went back to school quickly and called Walter, who was still studying in the library.
It was almost five o'clock and there was no one in school.
We went upstairs to the science lab.
The door of the lab was open and someone was inside.
Oh no, it's Mr. Phillips, the janitor.
Walter whispered, let's hide in the bathroom.
We hid in the bathroom for a few minutes.
Then we heard Mr. Phillips go downstairs.
Okay, now we can go to the lab.
We went inside the lab and looked around.
There was a big sign on each cupboard that said danger, toxic chemicals inside.
We opened the two big ones and looked at every bottle.
Then we looked inside the smallest one and found a small black spray can.
All the other bottles and cans have a name.
This must be Mr. Ken's spray.
He took it out of the small cupboard and said, it's very heavy.
Who wants to take it home?
My mother always looks around in my room.
A spray can from another planet.
Walter, Barbara and I went home because we had a lot of homework to do.
After dinner, the phone rang and I answered it.
Can you come to my house?
I have to talk to you.
It's eight o'clock and I'm doing my homework, I said.
I'll be there in fifteen minutes, I said.
I quickly put on my jacket and ran downstairs to the living room.
My mom was reading the newspaper and my dad was watching TV.
Text was sitting next to them.
Mom, I'm taking text out for a walk.
Yeah, I'm tired of studying, I said.
I really need to take a walk and get some fresh air.
I'll be back by nine o'clock.
Some fresh air is good for you, Karen.
Tex and I walked down the street and crossed the park quickly.
What did Walter want at this time?
It was a warm evening and there was a full moon in the sky.
